effective_protocol.name: controlled re-evaluation of public memory architectures under a unified fully-local model stack

dependency_audit.openai_sdk_role: local OpenAI-compatible protocol client only; endpoint guarded to loopback

main_reader_answer.endpoint_policy: must be loopback; never falls back to OPENAI_BASE_URL

main_reader_runtime.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 Laptop GPU; 16376 MiB

memory_system.meaning: ingestion, storage, retrieval and context construction; not a model/provider role

embedding.main_track_runtime: local CUDA Transformers on cuda:0 / float16; shared by every dense-compatible system
embedding.torch_overlay: 2.10.0+cu128 from the official PyTorch CUDA 12.8 wheel index; local overlay only, uv.lock unchanged
embedding.query_instruction: Instruct: Given a conversation-history question, retrieve memory passages that provide evidence needed to answer the question.\nQuery:

roles.deterministic_metric: LongMemEval token precision/recall/F1 and normalized exact match; local, no model call

context_controlled_track.shared_reader: frozen local Qwen3-8B; same prompt, temperature 0, seed 42, thinking=false, max_new_tokens=256

systems.name: FullContext
systems.long_context_gate: 131072 slot; tokenizer prompt count and truncated=false required per answer

systems.name: OpenClaw
systems.retrieval: pinned chunking and hybrid BM25/vector ranking unchanged

systems.name: Mem0 OSS
systems.dependency: mem0ai==1.0.3 (pinned in upstream uv.lock; installed in isolated benchmark .venv)
systems.memory_ingestion_endpoint: injected frozen local Qwen3-8B reader client
systems.static_audit: pinned Mem0 source exposes memory.llm.client and memory.embedding_model.client; adapter fails closed if not
systems.local_execution: same upstream Qdrant backend, explicit 1024 dimensions for shared Qwen embedding, run-scoped local path

systems.name: SimpleMem
systems.reader_endpoint: role-aware reader client; planner/retrieval uses memory_reasoning; final ask capped at shared 256 tokens
systems.memory_ingestion_endpoint: imported SimpleMem OpenAI aliases patched to loopback Qwen3-8B client
systems.embedding_endpoint: shared local Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B client through existing EmbeddingModel adapter
systems.local_execution: upstream parallel-window path retained; worker limits set to 1 to match the shared single-slot local reader and shared local embedding adapter; planner calls use memory_reasoning
systems.fail_closed: requires at least one patchable sync OpenAI alias and rejects AsyncOpenAI
systems.runtime_audit: simplemem==0.1.0 and mem0ai==1.0.3 installed from the pinned lock; exact imports passed

systems.name: PropMem
systems.memory_ingestion_endpoint: reader client; 8192-token extraction budget preserved, temperature 0 and seed 42 in Main Track
systems.embedding_endpoint: shared local Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B client injected into PropMemSystem
systems.local_execution: upstream per-session extraction path retained with one worker to match the shared single-slot local reader and embedding adapters; local request timeout is 3600s
systems.failure_handling: extraction/schema/provider failures propagate as infrastructure failures instead of empty propositions

partial run stopped before freeze after identifying the Mem0 Qdrant dimension mismatch; outputs retained as diagnostic only so the official smoke uses one final patch SHA

r5 full five-system attempt: PropMem's 64-token final-answer cap produced incomplete JSON. No hosted calls; run retained as infra-failure diagnostic, not scored.
